articles.summary: Strong net interest margin and operating efficiency drive robust earnings and tangible book value expansion HAMILTON, N.J., Oct. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Bank (Nasdaq Global Market: FRBA) ("the Bank") today announced results for the third quarter of 2025. Net income for the third quarter of 2025 was $11.7 million, or $0.47 per diluted share, compared to $8.2 million, or $0.32 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2024.
